messages:
nora: Midweek ops bulletin: short release-train embargo Wednesday 00:45-04:45 UTC for a proactive kernel security patch. We'll tilt canary traffic to eu-central for ~50m around 02:30 UTC. Post exceptions by 20:00 PT today.

kyle: Affected stacks?

nora: Affected: inference-core, cache-service, router. Not affected: portal, analytics. Customer-dedicated pools only on explicit coord.

izzy: We have a rerank experiment finishing Wed morning (owner: izzy). It's kernel-free. Requesting exception to finish ramp.

nora: Please include a short risk note. Kernel-free, smoke-passed rollouts typically allowed.

izzy: Exception: rerank-experiment (owner: izzy) - smoke ok, no quant/kernel touches. Request allowed to finish.

deploy-bot: Exception logged: rerank-experiment. Exception ID: RTX-502. Auto-rollouts permitted for this rollout only. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Preflight summary:
- infra health: ok
- db lag: <300ms
- alerting hooks: verified
- canary baselines: nominal
All clear. Note: model-cache warming may show temporary higher miss rate on first traffic.

nora: Tilt command for runbook: `routingctl shift --from global-canary --to eu-central-tilt --percent 70 --duration 50m`

ops-bot: Infra provision command (if needed): `infractl provision --zone eu-central-1 --type gpu-small --count 2 --ttl 2h`

kyle: Fallback policy (added):
```
trigger: sustained error-rate > 1.2% OR p95 > 2s for 3 windows
action: stop canary, route->stable, notify->#incidents, run rolling restart router
```

oncall: We'll post 5-min status updates during the tilt. Escalate in-thread for immediate rollback.

nora: Final: exceptions close at 20:00 PT. If you need emergency exceptions after that, DM @oncall with rollback plan. I'll push the Console banner shortly. :mega:
